candidates.title: MLC polls: Supriya Sule flags spy-cam pen allegations, Devendra Fadnavis responds
candidates.excerpt: NCP (SP) leader Supriya Sule has alleged that the BJP is using spy-camera pens to record voters in the Pune Teachers’ and Graduates’ MLC polls. Voters were reportedly asked to clip the pens to their pockets, film their ballots and collect money on showing the video. Sule urged the Election Commission to investigate. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said he doesn’t know what a spycam pen is. Counting is scheduled for October 27.
